input.text:
It's 11pm on the last day of the quarter and you are still matching receipts to bank lines. You are not alone: most of the 140 practice owners we work with told us the same thing before they switched.

Books done and tax-ready every month, without you touching a receipt. Here's how it works:
- Week one: we connect your bank feeds and set up receipt capture on your phone.
- Every month: a one-page cash summary lands in your inbox by the 5th.
- At year end: your accountant gets clean books, so their bill drops.

Because we reconcile daily rather than monthly, errors are caught while they are still small. Compared with a spreadsheet, clients save a median of 6 hours a month (2025 client survey, n=112).

"We cut month-end close from 9 days to 3." Priya Shah, Finance Director, Northwind Logistics

You might be wondering what happens if we get something wrong. If your accountant ever finds an error we made, we fix it free and refund that month. We are not the right fit for companies with more than 50 staff; at that size you need an in-house team, and we'll happily recommend one.

We take four new clients each month. Book a 20-minute call this week and you'll have a fixed quote within 2 working days.

sentences.text: It's 11pm on the last day of the quarter and you are still matching receipts to bank lines.
You are not alone: most of the 140 practice owners we work with told us the same thing before they switched.
Books done and tax-ready every month, without you touching a receipt.
- Week one: we connect your bank feeds and set up receipt capture on your phone.
- Every month: a one-page cash summary lands in your inbox by the 5th.
- At year end: your accountant gets clean books, so their bill drops.
Because we reconcile daily rather than monthly, errors are caught while they are still small.
Compared with a spreadsheet, clients save a median of 6 hours a month (2025 client survey, n=112).
"We cut month-end close from 9 days to 3."
Priya Shah, Finance Director, Northwind Logistics
You might be wondering what happens if we get something wrong.
If your accountant ever finds an error we made, we fix it free and refund that month.
We are not the right fit for companies with more than 50 staff; at that size you need an in-house team, and we'll happily recommend one.
We take four new clients each month.
Book a 20-minute call this week and you'll have a fixed quote within 2 working days.
